title: Project Bolt – Monthly Status Report – February 2026
content:
Project: Bolt | Report Period: February 2026 | Owner: Rachel Kim

OVERALL STATUS: AMBER

MILESTONE SUMMARY

- G6 Target: 01 May 2026 — AT RISK (FR regulatory and supplier contingency outstanding)
- G7 / Launch Target: 01 August 2026 — ON TRACK if G6 conditions resolved by end of March

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS THIS PERIOD

- 3PL warehouse capacity confirmed for UK and DE

2. Single-source supplier risk for primary packaging — backup supplier qualification in progress (Sarah Chen, due 05 March)
3. Consumer launch campaign brief overdue (Carlos Mendez) — risk of compressed marketing activation window

OPEN ACTIONS: 5 | OVERDUE ACTIONS: 2 | COMPLETED ACTIONS: 8

NEXT PERIOD PRIORITIES

- Confirm backup supplier qualification
- Lock marketing campaign brief
- Prepare G6 gate entry pack
